messageValues.message:
Tu es le routeur d'intentions et extracteur de paramètres de GovSuite.
Retourne uniquement un objet JSON valide, sans texte autour.
Intentions autorisées: GET_SERVICES, GET_AVAILABILITY, CREATE_APPOINTMENT, GET_APPOINTMENT, CANCEL_APPOINTMENT, RESCHEDULE_APPOINTMENT, GENERAL.
Extrais seulement les valeurs explicitement fournies; sinon null.
Champs: intent, confidence, service, site, dateDebut, dateFin, slotId, token, newSlotId, nom, prenom, email, telephone.
service doit être en majuscules (PASSEPORT, VISA, LEGALISATION, ETAT_CIVIL). site en majuscules. Dates au format YYYY-MM-DD.
N'invente jamais de valeur.
Format:
{"intent":"GET_SERVICES","confidence":0.99,"service":null,"site":null,"dateDebut":null,"dateFin":null,"slotId":null,"token":null,"newSlotId":null,"nom":null,"prenom":null,"email":null,"telephone":null}


RÈGLES STRICTES DE CLASSIFICATION :

- Mentionner une démarche comme "renouvellement de passeport",
  "demande de visa", "état civil" ou "légalisation"
  NE signifie PAS que l'utilisateur veut créer un rendez-vous.

- CREATE_APPOINTMENT doit être utilisé UNIQUEMENT si l'utilisateur
  exprime explicitement son intention de prendre ou réserver un rendez-vous.

Exemples CREATE_APPOINTMENT :
"Je veux prendre rendez-vous"
"Je souhaite réserver un rendez-vous"
"Réservez-moi ce créneau"
"Je veux prendre le créneau suivant"

- Si l'utilisateur demande simplement une démarche consulaire,
  par exemple :
  "renouvellement de passeport"
  "je veux renouveler mon passeport"
  "comment faire un passeport"
  utiliser GET_SERVICES.

- Si l'utilisateur demande des horaires ou des créneaux :
  utiliser GET_AVAILABILITY.

- Ne jamais choisir CREATE_APPOINTMENT s'il n'existe pas
  d'intention explicite de réservation.

SELECT *
FROM ai_conversation_state
WHERE session_id = $1
  AND (
      expires_at IS NULL
      OR expires_at > NOW()
  )
LIMIT 1;

WITH input AS (
    SELECT $1::jsonb AS data
),
prepared AS (
    SELECT
        NULLIF(data->>'sessionId', '') AS session_id,
        data AS payload,
        NULLIF(data->>'intent', '') AS intent,
        NULLIF(data->>'service', '') AS service,
        NULLIF(data->>'site', '') AS site,
        CASE
            WHEN NULLIF(data->>'dateDebut', '') IS NULL
              OR LOWER(data->>'dateDebut') IN ('null', 'undefined')
            THEN NULL
            ELSE (data->>'dateDebut')::date
        END AS date_debut,
        CASE
            WHEN NULLIF(data->>'dateFin', '') IS NULL
              OR LOWER(data->>'dateFin') IN ('null', 'undefined')
            THEN NULL
            ELSE (data->>'dateFin')::date
        END AS date_fin,
        CASE
            WHEN NULLIF(data->>'slotId', '') IS NULL
              OR LOWER(data->>'slotId') IN ('null', 'undefined')
            THEN NULL
            ELSE (data->>'slotId')::uuid
        END AS slot_id,
        CASE
            WHEN NULLIF(data->>'token', '') IS NULL
              OR LOWER(data->>'token') IN ('null', 'undefined')
            THEN NULL
            ELSE (data->>'token')::uuid
        END AS token,
        CASE
            WHEN NULLIF(data->>'newSlotId', '') IS NULL
              OR LOWER(data->>'newSlotId') IN ('null', 'undefined')
            THEN NULL
            ELSE (data->>'newSlotId')::uuid
        END AS new_slot_id,
        NULLIF(data->>'reference', '') AS reference,
        NULLIF(data->>'nom', '') AS nom,
        NULLIF(data->>'prenom', '') AS prenom,
        NULLIF(data->>'email', '') AS email,
        NULLIF(data->>'telephone', '') AS telephone,
        NULLIF(data->>'pendingAction', '') AS pending_action,
        NULLIF(data->>'conversationStep', '') AS conversation_step,
        CASE
            WHEN jsonb_typeof(data->'availableSlots') = 'array'
            THEN data->'availableSlots'
            ELSE NULL
        END AS available_slots,
        CASE
            WHEN NULLIF(data->>'selectedSlotIndex', '') IS NULL
              OR LOWER(data->>'selectedSlotIndex') IN ('null', 'undefined')
            THEN NULL
            ELSE (data->>'selectedSlotIndex')::integer
        END AS selected_slot_index,
        NULLIF(data->>'originalMessage', '') AS last_user_message
    FROM input
),
existing AS (
    SELECT s.*
    FROM ai_conversation_state AS s
    INNER JOIN prepared AS p
        ON s.session_id = p.session_id
    FOR UPDATE
),
resolved AS (
    SELECT
        p.session_id,
        CASE WHEN p.payload ? 'intent' THEN p.intent ELSE e.intent END AS intent,
        CASE WHEN p.payload ? 'service' THEN p.service ELSE e.service END AS service,
        CASE WHEN p.payload ? 'site' THEN p.site ELSE e.site END AS site,
        CASE WHEN p.payload ? 'dateDebut' THEN p.date_debut ELSE e.date_debut END AS date_debut,
        CASE WHEN p.payload ? 'dateFin' THEN p.date_fin ELSE e.date_fin END AS date_fin,
        CASE WHEN p.payload ? 'slotId' THEN p.slot_id ELSE e.slot_id END AS slot_id,
        CASE WHEN p.payload ? 'token' THEN p.token ELSE e.token END AS token,
        CASE WHEN p.payload ? 'newSlotId' THEN p.new_slot_id ELSE e.new_slot_id END AS new_slot_id,
        CASE WHEN p.payload ? 'reference' THEN p.reference ELSE e.reference END AS reference,
        CASE WHEN p.payload ? 'nom' THEN p.nom ELSE e.nom END AS nom,
        CASE WHEN p.payload ? 'prenom' THEN p.prenom ELSE e.prenom END AS prenom,
        CASE WHEN p.payload ? 'email' THEN p.email ELSE e.email END AS email,
        CASE WHEN p.payload ? 'telephone' THEN p.telephone ELSE e.telephone END AS telephone,
        CASE WHEN p.payload ? 'pendingAction' THEN p.pending_action ELSE e.pending_action END AS pending_action,
        CASE WHEN p.payload ? 'conversationStep' THEN p.conversation_step ELSE e.conversation_step END AS conversation_step,
        CASE WHEN p.payload ? 'availableSlots' THEN p.available_slots ELSE e.available_slots END AS available_slots,
        CASE WHEN p.payload ? 'selectedSlotIndex' THEN p.selected_slot_index ELSE e.selected_slot_index END AS selected_slot_index,
        CASE WHEN p.payload ? 'originalMessage' THEN p.last_user_message ELSE e.last_user_message END AS last_user_message
    FROM prepared AS p
    LEFT JOIN existing AS e
        ON e.session_id = p.session_id
)
INSERT INTO ai_conversation_state (
    session_id,
    intent,
    service,
    site,
    date_debut,
    date_fin,
    slot_id,
    token,
    new_slot_id,
    reference,
    nom,
    prenom,
    email,
    telephone,
    pending_action,
    conversation_step,
    available_slots,
    selected_slot_index,
    last_user_message,
    updated_at,
    expires_at
)
SELECT
    session_id,
    intent,
    service,
    site,
    date_debut,
    date_fin,
    slot_id,
    token,
    new_slot_id,
    reference,
    nom,
    prenom,
    email,
    telephone,
    pending_action,
    conversation_step,
    available_slots,
    selected_slot_index,
    last_user_message,
    NOW(),
    NOW() + INTERVAL '2 hours'
FROM resolved
ON CONFLICT (session_id) DO UPDATE SET
    intent = EXCLUDED.intent,
    service = EXCLUDED.service,
    site = EXCLUDED.site,
    date_debut = EXCLUDED.date_debut,
    date_fin = EXCLUDED.date_fin,
    slot_id = EXCLUDED.slot_id,
    token = EXCLUDED.token,
    new_slot_id = EXCLUDED.new_slot_id,
    reference = EXCLUDED.reference,
    nom = EXCLUDED.nom,
    prenom = EXCLUDED.prenom,
    email = EXCLUDED.email,
    telephone = EXCLUDED.telephone,
    pending_action = EXCLUDED.pending_action,
    conversation_step = EXCLUDED.conversation_step,
    available_slots = EXCLUDED.available_slots,
    selected_slot_index = EXCLUDED.selected_slot_index,
    last_user_message = EXCLUDED.last_user_message,
    updated_at = NOW(),
    expires_at = NOW() + INTERVAL '2 hours'
RETURNING
    session_id AS "sessionId",
    intent,
    service,
    site,
    date_debut AS "dateDebut",
    date_fin AS "dateFin",
    slot_id AS "slotId",
    token,
    new_slot_id AS "newSlotId",
    reference,
    nom,
    prenom,
    email,
    telephone,
    pending_action AS "pendingAction",
    conversation_step AS "conversationStep",
    available_slots AS "availableSlots",
    selected_slot_index AS "selectedSlotIndex",
    last_user_message AS "originalMessage",
    created_at AS "createdAt",
    updated_at AS "updatedAt",
    expires_at AS "expiresAt"

UPDATE ai_conversation_state
SET
    available_slots = $2::jsonb,
    selected_slot_index = NULL,
    updated_at = NOW(),
    expires_at = NOW() + INTERVAL '2 hours'
WHERE session_id = $1
RETURNING *;

SELECT
    COUNT(*)::int AS count,
    COALESCE(
        json_agg(t ORDER BY t.debut),
        '[]'::json
    ) AS slots
FROM (
    SELECT
        c.id,
        s.code AS service,
        si.code AS site,
        c.debut,
        c.fin,
        c.capacite,
        c.places_reservees,
        (c.capacite - c.places_reservees) AS places_disponibles
    FROM creneaux c

    JOIN services s
        ON s.id = c.service_id

    JOIN sites si
        ON si.id = c.site_id

    WHERE s.code = $1
      AND si.code = $2

      AND c.debut >= $3::date
      AND c.debut < ($4::date + INTERVAL '1 day')

      AND c.statut = 'DISPONIBLE'

      AND c.places_reservees < c.capacite

      AND c.debut > NOW()

    ORDER BY c.debut
) t;

UPDATE ai_conversation_state
SET
    pending_action = 'RESCHEDULE_APPOINTMENT',
    conversation_step = 'ASK_RESCHEDULE_CONFIRMATION',

    token = $2,
    new_slot_id = $3,

    updated_at = NOW(),
    expires_at = NOW() + INTERVAL '2 hours'

WHERE session_id = $1

SELECT
  id::text AS attempt_id,
  status AS attempt_status,
  appointment_reference,
  lease_until,
  expires_at,
  resume_count
FROM public.ai_appointment_attempt
WHERE session_id = $1
  AND status IN ('AWAITING_CONFIRMATION', 'SUBMITTING', 'UNCERTAIN', 'CONFIRMED')
ORDER BY created_at DESC
LIMIT 1;

WITH input AS (
  SELECT $1::jsonb AS data
)
INSERT INTO public.ai_appointment_attempt (
  id, session_id, idempotency_key, request_payload, request_fingerprint, status, expires_at
)
SELECT
  (data->>'attemptId')::uuid,
  data->>'sessionId',
  data->>'idempotencyKey',
  data->'requestPayload',
  data->>'fingerprint',
  'AWAITING_CONFIRMATION',
  NOW() + INTERVAL '2 hours'
FROM input
WHERE (data->>'idempotencyKey') ~ '^[A-Za-z0-9._~-]{16,128}$'
  AND (data->'requestPayload'->>'cleIdempotence') = data->>'idempotencyKey'
RETURNING id::text AS attempt_id, status;

WITH input AS (
  SELECT $1::jsonb AS data
),
entropy AS (
  SELECT 'own-' || encode(public.gen_random_bytes(16), 'hex') AS lease_owner
)
SELECT f.acquired, f.attempt_id::text, f.attempt_status, f.request_payload, f.idempotency_key, f.request_fingerprint, f.resume_count, e.lease_owner
FROM input
CROSS JOIN entropy e
CROSS JOIN LATERAL public.reclamer_tentative_rendez_vous(
  (input.data->>'attemptId')::uuid,
  input.data->>'sessionId',
  e.lease_owner
) AS f;

WITH input AS (

CROSS JOIN LATERAL public.reprendre_tentative_rendez_vous(

) AS f;

WITH input AS (
  SELECT $1::jsonb AS data
)
SELECT
  data->>'attemptId' AS "attemptId",
  data->>'sessionId' AS "sessionId",
  data->>'idempotencyKey' AS "idempotencyKey",
  data->'requestPayload' AS "requestPayload",
  encode(public.digest(convert_to(data->>'canonical', 'UTF8'), 'sha256'), 'hex') AS fingerprint
FROM input
WHERE data->>'frozenReady' = 'true'
  AND (data->>'idempotencyKey') ~ '^rec008-[0-9a-f]{64}$'
  AND (data->'requestPayload'->>'cleIdempotence') = data->>'idempotencyKey'
  AND length(data->>'canonical') BETWEEN 32 AND 8000
  AND octet_length(convert_to(data->>'canonical', 'UTF8')) BETWEEN 32 AND 8000;

WITH input AS (
  SELECT $1::jsonb AS data
)
UPDATE public.ai_conversation_state AS s
SET
  pending_action = NULL,
  conversation_step = NULL,
  nom = NULL,
  prenom = NULL,
  email = NULL,
  telephone = NULL,
  slot_id = NULL,
  service = CASE WHEN input.data->>'modifyField' = 'all' THEN NULL ELSE s.service END,
  site = CASE WHEN input.data->>'modifyField' = 'all' THEN NULL ELSE s.site END,
  date_debut = CASE WHEN input.data->>'modifyField' = 'all' THEN NULL ELSE s.date_debut END,
  date_fin = CASE WHEN input.data->>'modifyField' = 'all' THEN NULL ELSE s.date_fin END,
  available_slots = CASE WHEN input.data->>'modifyField' = 'all' THEN NULL ELSE s.available_slots END,
  updated_at = NOW(),
  expires_at = NOW() + INTERVAL '2 hours'
FROM input
WHERE s.session_id = input.data->>'sessionId'
RETURNING s.session_id AS "sessionId";
